{{Top|leg}}
A '''hive ball''' was a type of grand gala thrown by the [[X'Ting]] on [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]]. It was held in celebration of important events or to fete important visitors. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a hive ball was hosted by Regent [[G'Mai Duris]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] diplomats, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Barrister]] [[Doolb Snoil]].
